items.desc: #creatorsearchinsights #matcha #strawberrymatcha #girlhood #wellnessjourney Here’s my go-to method for making the perfect strawberry matcha! 🫶🏼 1. Soak your chasen (bamboo whisk) in warm water for about a minute before using it.  2. Lay out all your equipment — I usually do 3 scoops per person (I’m making two servings here).  3. Use 2-3g of matcha powder with 40ml of water.  4. Don’t forget to sift the matcha powder!  5. Start by pouring around 8ml of room temperature water into the matcha and gently mix it to form a paste.  6. Then, pour in the rest of your water and whisk! Enjoy!
